source_provenance.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: native high-resolution hand-drawn consecutive sprite animation for a side-view beat-em-up. Create exactly SIX separately drawn full-body frames in a strict THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW sheet, read left-to-right then next row, square canvas about 1536x1536. The six figures MUST be isolated and completely separated by transparent gutters at least 40px. Genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the character: no gradient, no panel fill, no grid, no numbers, no labels, no floor/shadow, no text. Crisp opaque ink and cel-shaded color matching the character reference. No motion blur, no ghost images, no duplicate shifted drawings or digital rotations. Every frame must be a new anatomically articulated drawing. Keep complete feet, ponytail, clothing, and all weapon tips safely inside each cell; never crop. Aim for 360-430px actual body height per figure from skull crown (excluding hair) to soles, with unchanged head/torso/limb proportions across all frames. Same camera, same image scale, stable ground plane. This is consecutive one-shot victory animation: each subsequent pose changes smoothly and visibly toward the specified final pose, with no reverse back to idle. The reference establishes identity and proportions only; remove its colored background completely.
Character: Nobunaga, exact compact powerful ADULT masculine proportions and face from the reference, around 4.8-5 heads high (do not make a tall slim adult or baby). Black swept forelock and high thick black ponytail with red tie, mustache and pointed beard, scarlet lamellar armor with yellow-gold trim, scarlet floral gold-decorated cape, dark purple-black pants, red shin armor, black boots with thick gold soles. Long steel katana with gold guard and black hilt, black empty scabbard at left hip. No helmet. Keep the same costume, face, short strong torso and leg ratio in every frame. Three-quarter facing screen-right. Powerful proud victory, not an attack: he gathers his stance, raises the sword progressively above his head, lifts his chin and shouts, then holds it proudly. The sword remains a single complete real blade in each frame, no trails or energy effects.
Draw FIRST SIX global frames0..5 of a twelve-frame victory. Keep full high sword positions within generous upper margin and full boots inside each cell. Top-left/frame0: he finishes battle with katana low in right hand pointing diagonally down/right, torso slightly forward, feet wide. Top-middle/frame1: he draws his near foot a small step inward and brings torso upright, sword still low but less tilted down. Top-right/frame2: he plants both boots firmly in a balanced proud stance and pulls blade close along right side, hand at waist, elbow begins bending. Bottom-left/frame3: sword arm starts lifting, elbow bent, guard at lower chest and blade angled upwards, left hand naturally at waist. Top-middle of bottom row/frame4: right hand rises to shoulder height, katana steep diagonal upwards, torso opens and chin slightly lifts. Bottom-right/frame5: sword hand reaches eye level, elbow now opening above shoulder, blade tip above head; chest begins expanding and cape follows the shoulder. Clear visible progressive hand/shoulder/blade movement in EVERY frame. This is gathering the blade and lifting it, not fully sheathing it and not making another attack. Do not hold a sword static in front; no early duplicated poses.
